Retention Rates for the G2G Model with Time-Varying Covariates

Source: R/G2G_varying_functions.R
G2G_varying_retention.Rd

Computes the period-by-period retention rate implied by a fitted G2G model for one covariate path: the probability of surviving period t given survival through period t - 1, S(t) / S(t - 1), where S is the curve from G2G_varying_survival.

Usage

G2G_varying_retention(solution, X_mat)

Arguments

solution

A fitted model of class "G2Gcov" returned by G2G_varying_MLE. Its par holds r, alpha and the coefficients on the original covariate scale (alpha already absorbs the centering used in fitting), so X_mat needs no centering or scaling.

X_mat

Covariate values for each period, one row per period (t = 1, ..., T). Either a data frame containing the original covariate variables (factors and dummy variables are coded as in the fit, using the stored terms and factor levels; missing values are an error), or a matrix whose columns are named like the model coefficients (any order) or, if unnamed, already in the same order as the coefficients.

Value

Numeric vector of length T + 1: a leading 1 (for time 0), then S(1)/S(0), S(2)/S(1), ..., S(T)/S(T-1).

Examples

# \donttest{
  data(kb_data)
  kb_data$status <- 1L - kb_data$censor
  fit <- G2G_varying_MLE(
    "Surv(week, status) ~ coupon + anyp",
    data    = kb_data,
    subject = "id"
  )
#> Warning: The Hessian at the solution is not positive definite (or could not be inverted), so standard errors and confidence intervals are NA.
  path <- kb_data[kb_data$id == kb_data$id[1], c("coupon", "anyp")]
  G2G_varying_retention(fit, path)
#>           r (shape) 
#> 1.0000000 0.9208866 
# }
